description:
What backs the dollar debt against bitcoin, by collateral and by venue type (pools, isolated markets, vaults, the auction, corporate, posted cards), as the site's "How these loans are backed" panel shows it, with each observer named and the collateral rule stated. days (30 to 1500, default 30) sets the window of the series it carries. The corporate part carries the class totals; the rows for each company are get_corporate_instruments'.

Standard questions this tool answers (get_guide with question): SQ-M5.
name: get_debt_by_collateral
title: How the dollar debt is backed
